title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The diff does not introduce any raw SQL queries or string concatenation into SQL statements. The changes involve permission checks and logic for plugin tree manipulation using Django ORM methods (e.g., `get_descendants`, `pk` comparisons), which are safe against SQL injection.

The diff adds authorization checks to prevent IDOR (CWE-639) and information disclosure. Specifically, it adds `source_placeholder.has_add_plugins_permission` and `source_placeholder.check_source` checks before allowing plugin/placeholder copying. This ensures that a user cannot copy content from a placeholder they do not have permission to access, thereby preventing exfiltration of secret content. It also adds a check to prevent cyclic reparenting which could lead to DoS. The changes are security improvements.
